description: Hygiene sweep of 11 no-behavior-change doc/comment/dead-code corrections from the 2026-07-08 audits, plus one real version-parity test.

userStories.title: Fix cam binary HELP for next and plan
userStories.description: As an operator reading `cam --help`, I need the top-level command descriptions to match real behavior so that I do not expect a tmux pane from `cam next` or a non-existent `--issue` flag on `cam plan`.
acceptanceCriteria: The `next` HELP entry no longer claims it launches the loop as a tmux pane; it describes flipping the loop to active (active:true), matching README and real behavior. [oracle: file-assert grep -vq 'launch the autonomous loop as a tmux pane\|Launch the autonomous loop as a tmux pane' index.ts]

The `plan` HELP entry no longer advertises `plan [--issue <N>]`; it presents the issue id as a positional argument, matching PLAN_HELP (`cam plan [<N>]`, usage at index.ts:209). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'cam plan' index.ts && grep -vq 'plan \[--issue' index.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: index.ts (HELP entries at ~line 97 `plan [--issue <N>]` and ~line 99 `next ... launches the autonomous loop as a tmux pane`). Non-templated (index.ts is source, not embedded), so NO re-embed. Cross-check PLAN_HELP at index.ts:209 (`usage: 'cam plan [<N>]'`) as the ground truth for the corrected wording. No-behavior-change: only the HELP description strings move.

userStories.title: Fix version.ts comment and add package.json parity assert
userStories.description: As a maintainer bumping a release, I need the version comment to reflect that package.json already has a version field and a test that fails on drift so that src/version.ts and package.json cannot silently diverge (runbook r.4 gap).
acceptanceCriteria: The comment block in src/version.ts no longer says package.json has no version field / describes it as hypothetical (`if/when we add a version field`); it accurately states package.json already carries the version and both are asserted equal by test/version.test.ts. [oracle: file-assert grep -vq 'if/when we add a' src/version.ts]

test/version.test.ts contains a real parity assertion that reads the `version` field from package.json and asserts it strictly equals CAM_VERSION, so version drift fails the suite. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'package.json' test/version.test.ts]
The parity test passes against the current tree (package.json 0.108.0 === CAM_VERSION 0.108.0). [oracle: bun test test/version.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/version.ts (comment at lines 12-14), test/version.test.ts. This is the ONLY new-test item in the sweep and is audit-authorized (not speculative). Read package.json via Bun.file / import assertion the Bun way; existing test/version.test.ts imports CAM_VERSION from '../src/version.ts'. Non-templated, no re-embed.

userStories.title: Remove stale merge-watch comment and dead CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS branch
userStories.description: As a maintainer reading the supervisor/release source, I need stale references and dead code removed so that comments and branches do not describe extinct behavior (no prompt emits CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS).
acceptanceCriteria: src/release/merge-watch.ts no longer references the extinct `cam-ship.md Step 7`; the comment reflects the real writer (runShipPrStep). [oracle: file-assert grep -vq 'Step 7' src/release/merge-watch.ts]

The dead CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS parsing branch in src/supervisor/result.ts (the `paneText.match(/CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS=\S+/)` block, emitted by no prompt) is removed along with its now-orphaned doc-comment line. [oracle: file-assert grep -vq 'CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS' src/supervisor/result.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/merge-watch.ts (comment ~line 288), src/supervisor/result.ts (dead branch ~line 398 plus the CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS doc line ~387). Both audit-authorized dead-removals, not speculative cleanup. Non-templated source, NO re-embed. Verify no other source or test references the removed branch (grep repo for CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS) before deleting; if a test asserts on it, update that test.

acceptanceCriteria: docs/adr/0004-plan-phase-deterministic-sidecar-runner.md carries a banner noting it is superseded by ADR-0006 (active:true -> setPhase). [oracle: file-assert grep -q '0006' docs/adr/0004-plan-phase-deterministic-sidecar-runner.md]

docs/adr/0006-phase-enum-loop-state-machine.md carries a status note that BLOCK auto-re-plans up to 2x via ADR-0012 and the shipping phase is in use via ADR-0009/0013. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '0012' docs/adr/0006-phase-enum-loop-state-machine.md]
docs/adr/0008-auto-ship-terminal-anchor.md carries a banner noting the callsite moved to runSidecarLoop per ADR-0013. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '0013' docs/adr/0008-auto-ship-terminal-anchor.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: docs/adr/0004-plan-phase-deterministic-sidecar-runner.md, docs/adr/0006-phase-enum-loop-state-machine.md, docs/adr/0008-auto-ship-terminal-anchor.md. docs/adr/ is repo-root DOMAIN MODEL, NOT templated: NO re-embed (gotcha in issue spec). Banner text is prose-only, no behavior change. Follow the global-CLAUDE no-emdash/no-emoji rule for persisted .md.

userStories.title: Correct cam-plan and cam-spec command docs (templated)
userStories.description: As an agent following the slash-command docs, I need cam-plan's example to use the padded issue filename and cam-spec to document its real success sentinel and error reason so that the docs match spec.ts and issue-specify.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: cam-plan.md line 12 example uses the N-padded filename CAM-0151.json (not CAM-151.json), consistent with the surrounding N-padded rule. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'CAM-0151.json' .claude/commands/cam-plan.md && grep -q 'CAM-0151.json' templates/commands/cam-plan.md]

cam-spec.md documents the success sentinel `CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha=` (emitted by spec.ts:318) and adds the `missing-main` reason (issue-specify.ts:106) to its error table. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN' .claude/commands/cam-spec.md && grep -q 'missing-main' .claude/commands/cam-spec.md]
Both copies (.claude/commands/ and templates/commands/) are edited identically and the embedded copy is regenerated (bun run embed-vendor). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Templated files (BOTH copies): .claude/commands/cam-plan.md + templates/commands/cam-plan.md; .claude/commands/cam-spec.md + templates/commands/cam-spec.md. After editing both copies run `bun run embed-vendor` to refresh src/templates/embedded.ts, then `bun run embed-vendor:check`. Gotcha (memory cam-dual-copy-is-per-file): the two copies are NOT guaranteed byte-identical outside the edited lines; diff before assuming, edit only the audited lines. Ground truth: spec.ts:318 emits `CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha=`; issue-specify.ts:106 uses reason `missing-main`.
